changes.title: Stuck key
items: Leaving the Studio's instruments (or the chart, the telescope or the zoo) no longer leaves a key stuck down, walking her on by herself

changes.title: Telescope moon
items: Through the telescope the moon stays put in the sky as you look around, instead of rising and falling with the view

changes.title: Ed leaf sliders
items: Ed's tuned forest colours are now the default: a little less autumn drift and a little more light-and-dark variety between trees, no hue turn
The cold blue-green grade over the whole picture is off, so the night keeps its own colours
